data.name: uq_local_profiles_server_user
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_local_profiles_server_user ON local_profiles (server_user_id) WHERE server_user_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL

data.name: uq_local_profiles_single_guest
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_local_profiles_single_guest ON local_profiles (access_mode) WHERE access_mode = 'guest' AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL

data.name: uq_banks_cache_swift_code
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_banks_cache_swift_code ON banks_cache (swift_code) WHERE swift_code IS NOT NULL

data.name: uq_local_user_cards_default
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_local_user_cards_default ON local_user_cards (profile_id) WHERE is_default = 1 AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL

data.name: uq_local_merchants_server_id
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_local_merchants_server_id ON local_merchants (profile_id, server_merchant_id) WHERE server_merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "auth_user_id" TEXT NULL, "server_user_id" TEXT NULL, "access_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("access_mode" IN ('guest', 'authenticated')), "email" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "born_date_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "setup_completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local_only' CHECK("sync_status" IN ('local_only', 'pending', 'synced', 'failed', 'conflict')), "server_version" INTEGER NULL CHECK("server_version" IS NULL OR "server_version" >= 1), "last_synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "installation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memberships_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "max_cards" INTEGER NULL, "max_receipt_scans_per_month" INTEGER NULL, "max_cashback_calculations_per_month" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("dataset_version" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "banks_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "swift_code" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("dataset_version" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_cards_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bank_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "network" TEXT NULL, "card_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'credit', "annual_fee_decimal" TEXT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "last_verified_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "server_updated_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("dataset_version" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_category_codes_cache" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "valid_payment" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "server_updated_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("dataset_version" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reward_rules_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "credit_card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "reward_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "cashback_rate_decimal" TEXT NULL, "points_rate_decimal" TEXT NULL, "monthly_cap_amount_decimal" TEXT NULL, "minimum_transaction_decimal" TEXT NULL, "minimum_monthly_spend_decimal" TEXT NULL, "eligible_channel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'any', "conditions_text" TEXT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "confidence_ppm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("confidence_ppm" IS NULL OR "confidence_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000), "last_verified_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "server_updated_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("dataset_version" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reward_rule_mccs_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reward_rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mcc_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("dataset_version" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("reward_rule_id", "mcc_code", "match_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_mcc_candidates_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_server_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_name_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_text" TEXT NULL, "mcc_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "mcc_description" TEXT NULL, "payment_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK("payment_type" IN ('unknown', 'in_store', 'online', 'shopee_food', 'grab_food', 'other')), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence_ppm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("confidence_ppm" IS NULL OR "confidence_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_branches_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_text" TEXT NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_user_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "credit_card_id" TEXT NULL, "bank_id" TEXT NULL, "bank_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, "billing_cycle_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("billing_cycle_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("credit_limit_minor" >= 0), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "has_annual_fee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_annual_fee" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local_only' CHECK("sync_status" IN ('local_only', 'pending', 'synced', 'failed', 'conflict')), "server_version" INTEGER NULL CHECK("server_version" IS NULL OR "server_version" >= 1), "last_synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_merchant_mcc_contributions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "merchant_server_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_text" TEXT NULL, "mcc_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "mcc_description_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "payment_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("payment_type" IN ('unknown', 'in_store', 'online', 'shopee_food', 'grab_food', 'other')), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "merchant_server_id", "mcc_code", "payment_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("operation" IN ('create', 'update', 'delete')), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("payload_version" >= 1), "base_server_version" INTEGER NULL CHECK("base_server_version" IS NULL OR "base_server_version" >= 1), "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("attempt_count" >= 0), "next_attempt_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NULL, "dataset_version" INTEGER NULL CHECK("dataset_version" IS NULL OR "dataset_version" >= 1), "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_attempt_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_success_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "next_check_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scope"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_merchants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "server_merchant_id" TEXT NULL, "name_raw" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_normalized" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_text" TEXT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VN' CHECK(LENGTH("country_code") = 2), "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local_only' CHECK("sync_status" IN ('local_only', 'pending', 'synced', 'failed', 'conflict')), "server_version" INTEGER NULL CHECK("server_version" IS NULL OR "server_version" >= 1), "last_synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_cards (id), "merchant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES local_merchants (id), "transaction_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" >= 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VND' CHECK(LENGTH("currency") = 3), "mcc_code" TEXT NULL CHECK("mcc_code" IS NULL OR LENGTH("mcc_code") = 4), "mcc_source" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "cashback_estimated_minor" INTEGER NULL, "cashback_confidence_ppm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("cashback_confidence_ppm" IS NULL OR "cashback_confidence_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local_only' CHECK("sync_status" IN ('local_only', 'pending', 'synced', 'failed', 'conflict')), "server_version" INTEGER NULL CHECK("server_version" IS NULL OR "server_version" >= 1), "last_synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_cashback_calculations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_cards (id), "reward_rule_id" TEXT NULL, "estimated_cashback_minor" INTEGER NULL, "applied_rate_ppm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("applied_rate_ppm" IS NULL OR "applied_rate_ppm" >= 0), "confidence_ppm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("confidence_ppm" IS NULL OR "confidence_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000), "explanation" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'estimated', "calculation_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local' CHECK("calculation_source" IN ('local', 'server')), "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("transaction_id", "calculation_source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("server_version" >= 1), "detected_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "resolution" TEXT NULL CHECK("resolution" IS NULL OR "resolution" IN ('keep_local', 'keep_server', 'merged')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_local_profiles_sync_status ON local_profiles (sync_status, updated_at_ms)

CREATE INDEX idx_merchant_mcc_candidates_cache_mcc ON merchant_mcc_candidates_cache (mcc_code)
CREATE INDEX idx_merchant_branches_cache_name ON merchant_branches_cache (name_normalized)
CREATE INDEX idx_local_user_cards_profile_active ON local_user_cards (profile_id, deleted_at_ms)
